description: Public highlight identity and source anchoring alongside a Margin annotation.

subject.description: The matching Margin annotation URI and content CID.

article.description: The HTTP(S) article source, matching the referenced Margin target.

note.description: The current independently addressable attached Note companion.

positionAnchor.description: Verified source-page position for the quotation in the referenced Margin version. Reader positions are excluded.

textHash.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of normalized UTF-8 source text.

start.description: Inclusive Unicode code-point offset in normalized source text.

end.description: Exclusive Unicode code-point offset, greater than start.
